== virtualUSB

- Saving host machine settings in *Device Management* no longer disables virtualUSB on host machines with routing managed by Kobiton. Previously, after a save, the *Connect* button could become unavailable in the virtualUSB app, and the virtualUSB CLI rejected connections with "This device does not support virtualUsb feature yet."
- Host machines that were set up for virtualUSB before host machine settings moved to *Device Management* now show as self-managed and continue to connect.
